visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a mint-green parka and dark trousers walks with steady steps across a concrete platform. In the background, oversized white block letters spelling 'USHUAIA' stand against a backdrop of a calm bay and distant snowy peaks. The sky is bright with scattered white clouds. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of several postcards depicting a lighthouse on a rocky island. A pair of hands carefully applies a printed label or postage mark to the corner of one card. The lighting is even and indoor-focused. (3) The woman stands in a hallway next to a vibrant red 'CORREO ARGENTINO' mailbox. She holds a stack of the lighthouse postcards and slides them one by one into the metal slot. She is wearing a white tote bag on her shoulder. The environment appears to be a public post office or tourist information center.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To express feelings of remembrance and loss through a travel story. The video captures the creator sending postcards from the 'end of the world' to a loved one who is no longer there, blending travel exploration with personal grief.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A melancholic yet beautiful short-form narrative using the geographic extreme of Ushuaia as a metaphor for finality and distance.
